# RapidXml 1.13

`rapidxml.hpp` is RapidXml 1.13 by Marcin Kalicinski, unmodified. RapidXml is
offered under either the Boost Software License 1.0 or the MIT License; this
copy is used under the Boost Software License 1.0, included as

It is kept here instead of being downloaded because its only distribution
point, SourceForge, refuses scripted downloads.
